thread.title: Apple stock falls after report says company is preparing for 20% fewer iPhone shipments with this year's upcoming models - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple stock falls after report says company is preparing for 20% fewer iPhone shipments with this year's upcoming models - MarketWatch
text: Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.27% shares are down 1.4% in premarket trading Friday after the Nikkei Asian Review reported that the company has told suppliers to prepare roughly 20% fewer iPhone components for new devices launching later this year. The report, which cites unnamed industry sources, said that Apple prepared for up to 100 million units of its new iPhone models last year but is only expecting to ship 80 million of this year's new models. Shares of iPhone suppliers are also down in premarket trading. Cirrus Logic Inc.'s CRUS, +1.10% stock has fallen 1.5% and STMicroelectronics NV's STM, -1.50% stock is down 1.3%. Apple shares have gained 25% in the past 12 months, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.38% has risen 19%.
